stem_book: A person holds a bucket of weight 60 N. He walks 7 m along the horizontal path and then climbs up a vertical distance of 5 m. The work done by the man (on the bucket) is: (a) 300 N-m (b) 420 N-m (c) 720 N-m (d) none of these
reason: '(on the bucket)' added — the man's work on himself is not meant.
work: Horizontal walk: F ⊥ d → 0; climb: W = 60·5 = 300 J
